en.name: Painter
en.ability: You start knowing an in-play character. Each night*, choose a player: if they are the character you learned most recently, you learn another in-play character.

revisions.v1: You start knowing an in-play character. Each night*, choose a player: if they are the character you learned most recently, you learn another in-play character.

en.firstNightReminder: Show an in-play character token. Mark that player *MOST RECENTLY LEARNED*.
en.otherNightReminder: The Painter chooses a player. If they chose the player marked *MOST RECENTLY LEARNED*, show a new in-play character token.

zh.name: 画家
zh.ability: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一个在场角色。每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果他是你最近得知的角色，你会得知另一个在场角色。

revisions.v1: 在你的首个夜晚，你会得知一个在场角色。每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：如果他是你最近得知的角色，你会得知另一个在场角色。

zh.firstNightReminder: 告知他一个在场角色，并在该玩家角色标记旁放置“最近得知”标记。
zh.otherNightReminder: 让他选择一名玩家，如果他选中被标记“最近得知”的玩家，告知他一个新的在场角色。
